about: Route-finder rules. One source for the HTML route finder (assets/js/cadcalc.js), the Python CLI (python3 -m cadkit route), and the route-map figure. Derived from HANDBOOK.md section 1 'Choose a route' and workflows A-E. A recommendation is a starting point, not a guarantee of accuracy.

inputs.label: One image of a flat part, sign, or profile
One image of a turned shape (knob, bottle)
Several views of a mechanical part
Many overlapping photos of a textured object
An existing mesh, scan, or point cloud
A CT or MRI image volume

goals.label: A replacement part that must fit
Editable CAD I can change later
An organic subject with an exact mount or socket
A holder or stand for an object I own

A.name: Workflow A: one picture to a profile-based part
A.start: Correct perspective, trace a constrained outline, then extrude (flat) or revolve (turned)
A.missing: Thickness, back face, hidden bores, and true scale

B.name: Workflow B: several views to editable mechanical CAD
B.start: Choose a functional datum, measure key interfaces, fit sketches and analytic features

C.name: Workflow C: photographs to a printable organic mesh
C.start: Reconstruct, scale from a measured distance, clean conservatively, simplify deliberately
C.deliverable: Scaled, inspected print mesh plus a raw reference mesh

D.name: Workflow D: mesh or point cloud to engineering surfaces
D.start: Segment regions, fit planes and cylinders, rebuild freeform patches only where needed
D.deliverable: Editable surfaces or a hybrid mesh and CAD model
D.missing: Design intent behind noisy or worn regions

E.name: Workflow E: organic subjects with mechanical interfaces
E.start: Declare scale from a reference dimension, keep sockets and pins parametric, split along natural seams
E.deliverable: Sculpted mesh with parametric mounting features
E.missing: Pose, hidden surfaces, and pin engagement

H.name: Design around a held or purchased object
H.start: Measure the real object's envelope, sweep the insertion path, reserve grasp and visibility volumes
H.deliverable: Holder with explicit insertion path and finish allowance

G.name: AI-generated geometry as a concept candidate
G.start: Interpret proportions, treat generated surfaces as candidates, set scale by declaration
G.missing: Unseen geometry, actual scale, physical feasibility

V.name: Volume segmentation (CT or MRI)
V.start: Respect voxel spacing, segment structures, extract and check surfaces

checks: Reserve independent check lengths before modeling
Print an interface coupon before the full part
Inspect thin features in the slicer layer preview
Keep a faithful reference mesh apart from the print mesh
Change a major parameter and regenerate to test the constraints
Declare scale from a named reference dimension, not a bounding box
Test pin and socket fit with a coupon
Sweep the measured envelope along the real insertion path
Test the coupon in its finished, coated state

photo-set|editable.warning: A photogrammetry mesh is not editable CAD; rebuild the important features (Workflow D).

photo-set|replacement.warning: Photogrammetry surfaces need independent dimensions before they can define a fit.

mesh|decorative.warning: For a display print, clean and prepare the mesh (Workflow C) instead of rebuilding surfaces.

artwork|replacement.warning: A single artistic or generated image cannot set fit dimensions. Measure the mating part or obtain a drawing.

artwork|editable.warning: Generated surfaces are candidates; rebuild the parts you will edit as features.

volume|replacement.warning: Education-grade segmentation is not qualified for clinical or patient-specific manufacture.

turned-image|replacement.warning: Hidden bores and wall thickness are invisible in one image; measure them.

flat-image|replacement.warning: One image sets the outline only; thickness and hole fits come from measurement.
